newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Agrobanka stems liquidity drain - cenbank.
newsitem.headline: Czech Agrobanka stems liquidity drain - cenbank.

text.p: Czech bank Agrobanka a.s., put under central bank control earlier this week, should resolve its liquidity crunch by Friday, its central-bank appointed administrator said on Thursday.
"I expect that by the end of the week we will renew the normal operation of Agrobanka, if you speak of its position on the interbank market," administrator Jiri Klumpar told a news conference.
The Czech National Bank, following an all night meeting of the cabinet, on Tuesday put Agrobanka under "temporary" forced administration saying it was illiquid but not insolvent.

The central bank called on "large banks" to deposit up to six billion crowns with Agrobanka, the largest wholly-private bank, to help it through its crisis, linked to the failure of Plzen-based Kreditni Banka a.s. in August.
Klumpar said that "several billion" crowns had been withdrawn from Agrobanka within the first two days of the central bank's action.
He said the central bank had also extended a credit line to Agrobanka but did not disclose the size or conditions of the credit.
